steps.message: Listen exactly once to the first Session clip on track audio-track with all six metric families: level, spectral-centroid, attacks, mel-bands, pitch and spectral-shape. Consume the automatically returned analysis and use its pinned readTarget with ableton_context read to follow every continuation through the full captured range, including measured feature values, native support coverage and unavailable reasons. Report the measured stereo peak, available flatness, spread, rolloff and confidence values with their context, source ranges, definitions and coverage. Confidence is an algorithm score, not accuracy; pitch may be unavailable on this kick. Diagnostic snapshots are not qualified measurements. Retain the returned readTarget for later comparison; no raw measurement read or feature-ID discovery is needed. Do not capture again, change any source or launch settings, stop transport, seek, reset, or explicitly derive anything. Stop immediately on any failure.

Listen exactly once more to the same first Session clip on track audio-track with all six metric families: level, spectral-centroid, attacks, mel-bands, pitch and spectral-shape. Consume the returned analysis, using its pinned readTarget with ableton_context read for every continuation through the full range, including measured values, native support coverage and unavailable reasons. Read both captures' measured stereo peak, available flatness, spread, rolloff and confidence values. Compare their returned capture readTargets with featureTypes [peak-summary/v1], then search using the first readTarget as query, the second as scope, featureType peak-summary/v1 and withinCapture false. Follow all comparison/search continuations. Report the matched context and source range, canonical Euclidean distance definition, distance units, measured distance and coverage. Inspect all 15 canonical feature types and every measure's default musical values, units, timing and coverage from complete analysis pages, including pitch-grid availability without inventing valid pitch for this kick. Confidence is an algorithm score, not accuracy; no raw measurement read, verbose evidence detail or feature-ID discovery is needed. Do not make another capture, explicitly derive, stop transport, seek, reset, edit clips or change launch/source settings. Stop immediately on any failure.

Without capturing, deriving, editing, seeking, stopping transport or resetting anything, use ableton_context read with the two original pinned capture readTargets and includeHistorical true. Follow every continuation through each full range, including every feature's measured values, units, timing, coverage and unavailable reasons. Report the original contexts, measured peak, flatness, spread, rolloff and confidence, source ranges, definitions and coverage; do not treat confidence as accuracy or unavailable kick pitch as valid. Compare the original readTargets again with featureTypes [peak-summary/v1] and includeHistorical true, following every continuation, and report the persisted-values distance. No raw measurement read, verbose evidence detail or feature-ID discovery is needed. Stop immediately if any previously available original source or feature is unavailable or changed.
